integrity.euler_basis: Compactly supported Euler characteristic localizes to the fixed locus for algebraic C* actions, and projectivity converts it to ordinary topological Euler characteristic.
integrity.first_public_date_basis: The Baranovsky article is publicly indexed with publication date 2001-03-01.
integrity.fixed_point_basis: A one-parameter subgroup combining diagonal conjugation with a large relative scalar shift separates all off-diagonal coordinates; diagonal fixed weight spaces contain no nonzero nilpotent matrices.
integrity.object_basis: Baranovsky and Ngo--Sivic define the affine variety of commuting nilpotent pairs; Silva--Vainsencher explicitly studies its projective variety.
integrity.primary_slot_basis: The Silva--Vainsencher article on the same projective pair variety lists Mathematics Subject Classification 14N15 first, followed by 14M15.

scientific_limitations: The theorem gives ordinary Euler characteristic only; it does not determine Betti numbers, mixed Hodge structure, intersection cohomology, or singularity type.
The statement concerns the projectivized commuting-nilpotent pair variety, not a conjugation quotient.
The localization proof is short, so an older unindexed observation may exist.
title: Euler characteristic of the projective commuting-nilpotent pair variety
